title: powerops plan status --json
description: The JSON written by 'powerops plan status --json'.

path.description: Plan folder, relative to the working folder.

status.description: draft, approved, signed-off, implementing or done; null when the header is malformed.

review.description: pending, done or skipped; null when the header is malformed.

environment.description: Target environment name from the header, or null.

depth.description: How deep the planning questions go, or null.

supersedes.description: Folder name of the earlier plan this one replaces, or null.

openQuestions.description: Number of items under Open questions.

bodyHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the plan body, or null when the header is malformed.

reports.description: The agent reports found in the plan folder, in this order when present: review.md, security-solution.md, verify.md. Empty when there is none. A report's state or staleness is never a violation.

state.description: The value of the 'state:' line in the report's first four lines, as written (the known values are ready, blocked, failed and dropped; any other value also adds a warning), or null when there is no such line or the file was not read (a link, a binary file or one over 1 MB). review.md normally has none.

stale.description: True when the plan body changed since the report was written, that is, the report's 'plan-hash:' differs from bodyHash. It says nothing about the solution. Null when the report or the plan has no hash, or the file was not read.

violations.description: Problems that make 'plan status' exit non-zero.

warnings.description: Problems that do not change the exit code.
